description:
Street ambience before new year in Philippines. 
I made this recording during the afternoon of December 31st of 2016, in a street of Calapan city (Oriental Mindoro, Philippines). 
You can hear heavy traffic, many people talking, walking, and using horns. 
Recorded with an Olympus LS-3 and a Luhd PM-01M mono microphone (Primo em172). 
Fade in/out and high pass filter 120Hz -6dB/oct applied in Audacity.
